contact_exclusion: contact, reward, success, privileged simulator state, and all future/target fields are forbidden from training, fitting, selection, whitening, gate features, stopping, exclusions, and terminal statistics; contact may be inspected only after the immutable terminal decision for interpretation
episode_exclusions: none after a valid rollout is generated; generation replacement is allowed only for a mechanical exception or malformed rollout and never after inspecting outcome, loss, contact, reward, or success
missing_or_nonfinite_policy: fail the execution as v5_execution_invalid; do not delete, replace, or impute an analyzed episode
